metadata.title: Fusion 360 CAM 3D Milling Per-Op Tab Deep Pass — Strategy / Ramp / Holder / Output / Connections Coverage + PROJECT + FLAT
metadata.description: Deep-pass extension to 3d-operations.json (MS0/U-CAM22). Closes the input-exhaust gap by adding 5 previously-uncatalogued tabs (Strategy, Ramp, Holder, Output, Connections) to the 12 existing 3D milling ops via _DEEP entries (Adaptive/Pocket/Parallel/Contour/Scallop/Pencil/Radial/Spiral/Morphed-Spiral/Steep-Shallow/Horizontal/Ramp), AND introduces 2 net-new finishing ops (PROJECT_3D, FLAT_3D) that were missing entirely. Together brings Fusion 360 3D milling toward 100% input-field coverage per the L2-CAMX-EXHAUST mandate.
metadata.source: Autodesk Fusion 360 Help — 3D Milling reference (Adaptive Clearing 3D / Pocket Clearing 3D / Parallel / Contour 3D / Steep-Shallow / Scallop / Pencil / Horizontal / Morphed Spiral / Radial / Spiral / Ramp / Project / Flat) + HSM Best Practices Guide + post.cps Manual NC reference + Holder Collision Check documentation + 3D Linking strategies reference + Manufacturing Extension 5-axis tilt-extension reference

commonTabs.description: New tabs added by the deep pass on top of the existing base (tool/geometry/heights/passes/linking — note 8 of 12 simpler-finishing ops in 3d-operations.json only had tool/geometry/passes; deep pass treats Heights/Linking as covered by parent catalog).

ADAPTIVE_3D_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to adaptive_clearing_3d — adds Strategy (engagement / region order / smoothing), Ramp (helical 3D entry), Holder (5-axis tilt-extension envelope), Output (HSM-aware NURBS / G6.2 spline output), Connections (stay-down vs lift trade-off).

parameters.name: Optimal Load
parameters.description: Target radial engagement (woc) for 3D adaptive load control

parameters.name: Maximum Tilt Angle
parameters.description: Used by tilt_to_avoid mode (5-axis Mfg Ext)

POCKET_3D_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to pocket_clearing_3d — Strategy / Ramp / Holder / Output / Connections for offset-based 3D pocket clearing with Z-step pattern.

PARALLEL_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to parallel — Strategy (pass direction / multi-pass / cusp control) / Ramp / Holder / Output / Connections for raster-pattern 3D finishing.

parameters.name: Cusp Height
parameters.description: Target scallop height (drives stepover via ball-nose geometry)

parameters.name: Use Cusp Height
parameters.description: Compute stepover from cusp height instead of explicit stepover

CONTOUR_3D_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to contour 3D — Strategy (Z-level slicing / shallow-area auto-detect) / Ramp / Holder / Output / Connections for Z-level finishing.

parameters.name: Auto Skip Shallow Areas
parameters.description: Skip shallow surfaces (use scallop / parallel for those instead)

SCALLOP_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to scallop — adds Heights/Linking (missing in parent), Strategy/Ramp/Holder/Output/Connections for constant-scallop ball-nose finishing.

PENCIL_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to pencil — corner-cleanup finishing along internal radii. Heights/Linking + Strategy/Ramp/Holder/Output/Connections.

parameters.name: Reference Tool Diameter
parameters.description: Diameter of prior larger tool (drives where corners need cleanup)

RADIAL_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to radial — radial finishing pattern from a center point. Heights/Linking + Strategy/Ramp/Holder/Output/Connections.

SPIRAL_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to spiral — Archimedean-spiral finishing for round / circular boss / pocket areas. Heights/Linking + Strategy/Ramp/Holder/Output/Connections.

MORPHED_SPIRAL_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to morphed_spiral — boundary-following spiral finishing. Heights/Linking + Strategy/Ramp/Holder/Output/Connections.

STEEP_AND_SHALLOW_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to steep_and_shallow — combined Z-level (steep) + scallop (shallow) finishing in one op driven by slope-angle threshold. Heights/Linking + Strategy/Ramp/Holder/Output/Connections.

parameters.name: Slope Threshold Angle
parameters.description: Angle separating steep (Z-level) from shallow (scallop) regions

HORIZONTAL_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to horizontal — flat-area-only finishing pass. Heights/Linking + Strategy/Ramp/Holder/Output/Connections.

RAMP_DEEP.description: Deep-tab extension to ramp finishing — slope-following passes. Heights/Linking + Strategy/Ramp/Holder/Output/Connections.

PROJECT_3D.description: Net-new project-finishing op — projects a 2D sketch / curve onto the 3D model surface and follows it. Used for engraved details on curved surfaces, mold-line trim paths, decorative surface features. Missing entirely from MS0/U-CAM22 catalog.

FLAT_3D.description: Net-new flat-finishing op — auto-detects flat surfaces (within slope-angle tolerance) and finishes them with offset / spiral / raster pattern. Faster than horizontal for purely-flat regions because it skips slope checking. Missing entirely from MS0/U-CAM22 catalog.

parameters.name: Detection Tolerance Angle
parameters.description: Surface within this angle of horizontal is treated as flat

parameters.name: Finish Pass
parameters.description: Add final wall-pass at zero stock
